_comment: Allowlist for tests/test_third_party_imports.py. Shipped Python is standard-library only except the modules named here. Every entry names the PyPI distribution, its licence as read from the distribution's own licence file (see docs/launch/evidence/legal.md for the version, file and digest), whether the import is optional, and the shipped files allowed to import it. Adding an entry is a licence decision for the owner, not a test fix.
